editorial:
Imagine you and your best friends from college meet up every year for a big vacation. You are all doing great in life, with fancy jobs and nice houses, so everything seems perfect on the surface. You get a group of eight married friends who head to Colorado for their annual trip, but the good vibes do not last long. The movie kicks off with a lot of laughs and luxury, but it quickly turns into a rollercoaster of emotions when a huge secret about cheating comes out. Suddenly, the trip turns into a mirror for every couple there, forcing them to look at the cracks in their own marriages.

What really makes this work is how the arguments feel real, even when they get loud and dramatic. Some parts might feel a bit over the top, but that is just part of the charm. You will find yourself rooting for some couples and yelling at others. If you want something that mixes big laughs with serious heart, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with your partner.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the couples finally being honest about their struggles. After a lot of fighting and crying, most of them decide to work on their marriages through therapy and communication. The couple dealing with the cheating learns that forgiveness is hard but possible. Everyone leaves the trip with a better understanding of how to love their partners, proving that honesty is the only way to make a relationship last long term.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about friendship and marriage.
watchReasons: good mix of humor and tears
